product_updates.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
product_updates.content: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.
